title: QICN FCR Prediction Registry Schema
business_rules: required_artifacts and minimum_negative_controls must be non-empty arrays
epistemic_limit must contain at least 20 non-whitespace characters
if thresholds[].status starts with frozen_, thresholds[].value must not be null
if thresholds[].status starts with frozen_, thresholds[].date_frozen must match YYYY-MM-DD
if thresholds[].status starts with frozen_, thresholds[].rationale must contain at least 10 non-whitespace characters
linked_rivals, when present, must be a non-empty array of RIVAL-* ids
boundary: This schema validates registry structure only. It does not validate empirical truth, theorem truth, consciousness, phenomenality, identity transfer, or external adjudication.
